observations.text: SP was introduced to the special requirement directed by the Training Exercises analysis for this training unit at the level set by the Performance Standards (MIF), following through on the controls while the IP directed the entry and executed the demonstration. The briefed sequence was reproduced when each step was called, but no part of it was initiated without direction and the applicable limits were recalled only after prompting. Marginal performance for the Training Section - self-initiated execution of the special requirement is expected to develop in the following sorties, since the next Training Section requires practice to a set performance level rather than attendance at the demonstration.

SP, applying the special requirement briefing studied before the sortie, completed the item directed by the Training Exercises analysis with verbal prompts from the IP required only at the entry parameters, and no part of it had to be executed by the IP. The omission of one briefed step was recognized and corrected after prompting, before the next repetition was started. Above end of block MIF achieved.

SP practiced the special requirement specified for this training unit with minor errors in the sequencing of the briefed steps, each one recognized and corrected in a timely manner without IP's intervention. Neither the entry parameters nor the applicable limits required prompting, and the item was covered in full at the planned point of the mission profile. Above end of block MIF achieved.

SP executed the special requirement directed by the Training Exercises analysis accurately and at the planned point of the mission profile, without verbal prompts and without IP's intervention. Knowledge of the applicable procedures and limits was sufficient at every repetition, and the item was covered in the first sortie of the Training Section, which leaves the remaining sorties available for repetition. Above end of block MIF achieved.

SP, having briefed the special requirement and its applicable limits before the sortie, executed it with accuracy above the level expected at this stage of training, at the planned point of the mission profile and with no prompting at any time. Deviations in sequencing and execution were negligible and every repetition was flown within the briefed parameters. The item required by the Training Exercises analysis was covered beyond the minimum number specified for the Training Section. Above end of block MIF achieved.

SP, due to a review of the Training Exercises analysis that was not carried into the mission profile, did not sequence the special requirement of this training unit at a planned point and left it outstanding until the fuel state no longer allowed a repetition. The item was started only on the IP's direction and part of the setup was executed by the IP. The special requirement was not accomplished without assistance and is annotated in the grade sheet for execution in the next block.

SP, due to incomplete knowledge of the limits applicable to the maneuver, could not complete the special requirement directed by the Training Exercises analysis for this training unit and stopped the sequence after the first step. The IP directed the remaining actions and executed part of the procedure. The special requirement was not accomplished without assistance and, being a prerequisite for promotion, must be repeated before the Training Section is closed.

SP accomplished the special requirement specified by the Training Exercises analysis for this training unit within the level required by the Performance Standards (MIF), completing it after two verbal prompts from the IP on the entry parameters. Recognition that one briefed step remained outstanding was delayed until the IP called for it, although no intervention on the controls was needed. Marginal performance for the Training Section - independent tracking of the special requirement against the Training Exercises analysis, and its execution without prompting, are expected to improve in the following sorties.

SP planned and accomplished the special requirement of this training unit at the planned point of the mission profile, without verbal prompts from the IP. Minor errors in the sequencing of the briefed steps were recognized and corrected in a timely manner without IP's intervention. Above end of block MIF achieved.

SP executed the special requirement directed by the Training Exercises analysis with accuracy and speed, at the planned point of the mission profile and within the briefed parameters on every repetition. Knowledge of the applicable procedures and limits was sufficient throughout, and neither prompting nor IP's intervention was required. Above end of block MIF achieved.

SP, applying a mission profile prepared before the sortie, executed the special requirement of this training unit with exceptional accuracy and integrated it without degrading the accuracy of the other graded maneuvers or the planned timing of the sortie. Deviations in sequencing and execution were negligible, the applicable procedures and limits were briefed before each repetition, and the minimum number specified by the Training Exercises analysis was exceeded. No prompting was required at any point of the sortie. Above end of block MIF achieved.

SP, due to a mission profile flown without the planned points for the special requirement, did not start the item directed by the Training Exercises analysis at the briefed stage and attempted it out of sequence, without the preceding configuration and clearing checks. The IP took over the sequence and executed part of the procedure. The special requirement was not accomplished without assistance and is annotated in the grade sheet for execution in the next block.

SP, due to workload management that left the special requirement to the last part of the working phase, entered the item directed by the Training Exercises analysis without the briefed entry parameters and did not complete it. The IP directed the repetition and executed part of the sequence. The special requirement was not accomplished at the level required by the Performance Standards (MIF) and remains outstanding for this training unit.

SP, due to a step sequence recalled from the previous Training Section rather than from the Training Exercises analysis for this training unit, omitted one briefed step of the special requirement and applied a second one out of order. Both were completed after the IP's verbal prompts, with recognition delayed until the item was already in progress. No intervention on the controls was required, but the special requirement was not accomplished independently at the level set by the Performance Standards (MIF).

SP, due to lack of awareness of a published restriction that was available in the briefing material, began the special requirement of this training unit outside the conditions specified by the Training Exercises analysis, and the item was reset and flown again only after the IP's verbal prompt. Recognition of the restriction was delayed until it was named by the IP. The special requirement was covered without intervention on the controls, but not at the level required by the Performance Standards (MIF) for this training unit.

SP accomplished the special requirement specified by the Training Exercises analysis for this training unit within the level required by the Performance Standards (MIF), with two minor errors in the sequencing of the briefed steps that were recognized and corrected without IP's intervention. Both corrections were applied after the step had been started rather than at the point where it was set up, and speed of execution was below that shown on the other graded maneuvers of the sortie. Marginal performance for the Training Section - earlier self-recognition of the sequencing errors is expected to improve in the following sorties.

SP executed the special requirement of this training unit accurately and at the planned point of the mission profile, with no sequencing error and no prompting from the IP. Knowledge of the applicable procedures and limits was sufficient at every repetition, and the number of repetitions specified by the Training Exercises analysis was covered within the sortie. Above end of block MIF achieved.

SP, having briefed the special requirement and its applicable limits before the sortie, executed it with exceptional accuracy at the planned point of the mission profile, within the briefed parameters on every repetition and with no prompting at any time. Deviations in sequencing and execution were negligible, and the item was integrated without degrading the accuracy of the other graded maneuvers of the sortie. Repetition of the special requirement is not required before promotion to the next Training Section. Above end of block MIF achieved.
